content.value: While searching for new pair of shoes, you visited multiple e-commerce sites and may (10) [CO3] or may not have completed a purchase. Later, when browsing a social media platform, you noticed advertisements for the same types of shoes you had viewed earlier. Explain the underlying mechanism that enables such personalized advertisements across different websites.
